_comment: TicTacToe locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side).

_slots.{symbol}: The player's mark, either X or O
_slots.{opponent_symbol}: The opponent's mark, either X or O
_slots.{cell}: A board cell number between 0 and 8

player_prompt.intro:
Uyini Muteri {player_id} eTic Tac Toe.
Vuyelo byakwe i ku nyika misava yotori (hoxa, verticali, kuya na diagonal) ehenhla ka bhoza.
Laha u nga na mudiwo, u fanele ku koka nomboro ya skwela (0-8) u lungela simbolo yakwe eka yona.
Tanihi mfano, '[4]' ku nyika simbolo yakwe ehenhla ka seli ya bhoza.
Tanihi Muteri {player_id}, u va va '{symbol}', wile ripfumelo rakwe ri va '{opponent_symbol}'.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Ku rhurha loku ku rhumeriweke a hi ka muxaka lowu faneleke.
invalid_move.out_of_range: {cell} a hi sele leyi nga tirhiki. Yi fanele yi va exikarhi ka 0 na 8.

game_action.placed: Muteri {player_id} u hakele simbolo yakwe ({symbol}) eka seli {cell}.

outcome.draw: Ntlangu wu ve na ku ringana!
